content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Clock hands keep aligning when I have certain thoughts, like pointing at me.
I can’t confirm intention from hand positions. Which times and clocks were involved—analog, digital, both?
Analog mostly; the minute and hour line up when I think about a decision.
Analog hands coincide every so often by design. Logging exact times of alignment and comparing to a schedule of expected overlaps can show if it exceeds the baseline.
How do I get the schedule?
A simple chart of when hands overlap each hour exists; copying one into your notes lets you check whether your observed alignments occur outside the predicted windows.
If mine are always near the predicted times?
Then the pattern likely follows the clock’s cycle rather than thought timing.
Understood. I’ll compare for a week.
